explanation: Most diamonds crystallized from carbon in the mantle, over 150 km down, far below any coal. Many are over a billion years old, older than the land plants that coal comes from.

claims.text: Natural diamonds do not form from compressed coal.
Most natural diamonds formed in Earth's mantle at depths of more than 150 km.
Many natural diamonds are more than a billion years old.
Coal formed from the remains of land plants, which appeared less than 500 million years ago.
Coal seams lie in Earth's crust, far shallower than the depths at which diamonds form.
